_comment: PLANTPOTTING-0007 — maps the House Plant Species (47-class) MobileNetV2 model labels to KB speciesIds. Labels are the model's exact output-index order (see labels.csv). 8 exact + 2 coarse = 10 of 16 KB species covered (vs AIY's 2/16). Coarse rows (alias:true with a _note) map a broader model class onto the KB's single representative species; routing honesty still applies (a coarse high-confidence hit maps, a weak one routes low-confidence). 'Rattlesnake Plant (Calathea lancifolia)' is deliberately NOT mapped to goeppertia-orbifolia — it is a different Calathea species. See docs/kb/ml-mapping-notes.md.

Snake plant (Sanseviera)._note: Snake plant / Sansevieria trifasciata == Dracaena trifasciata

Orchid._note: COARSE: model class 'Orchid' is broader than the KB's Phalaenopsis; mapped because Phalaenopsis is the KB's only (and the most common houseplant) orchid. Flagged in ml-mapping-notes.

Calathea._note: COARSE/genus: Goeppertia orbifolia was formerly Calathea orbifolia; the model's generic 'Calathea' class is mapped to the KB's only Calathea/Goeppertia. The separate 'Rattlesnake Plant (Calathea lancifolia)' class is intentionally left unmapped (different species).
